You: Command line to update a git token?:
To update a git token in the command line, you can follow these steps:

1. Open your terminal and navigate to your project directory.
2. Run the command `git remote set-url origin https://username:token@github.com/username/repository.git` replacing `username`, `token`, `github.com/username/repository.git` with your actual GitHub username, token, and repository URL.
3. You can also use the `git config` command to update the token. For example, you can run `git config --global user.name "your_username"` and `git config --global user.email "your_email@example.com"`.

You can find more information on managing your personal access tokens in the GitHub documentation: https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/managing-your-personal-access-tokens
